exceptions.reason: The family has one part, and `index.ts` exports it. No namespace holds the parts.
No Base UI component imports the file. It is the module of the package entry `./internals/csp-context`, and Vase UI has no entry point for an internal module.

relocations.behavior: The key that a part reads with `inject(cspKey, null)`: the nonce and `disableStyleElements` of the nearest provider, or `null` with no provider.
